}}'''Kajin''' is a [[Shienar]]an nobleman from [[Fal Dara]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kajin, Lord}}

==Appearance==
He was tall, lean and sallow.

== Activities ==
He was checking to see who was missing in the [[Fal Dara]] keep to identify possible darkfriends.{{ref/book|2|6}}

He saluted [[Lan]] and [[Rand]] on their way to visit the [[Amyrlin]].{{ref/book|2|8}} He prevents Rand from entering the Women's quarters to see Egwene before he leaves to find the [[Horn of Valere]].
